items.title: Josef Balcerak Interview, 1968-05-17
items.q: Their favorites... became Polish musicians... Trzaskowski and Kurilewicz piano... arranged a series of concerts with the participation of enthusiastic groups from Warsaw, Krakow, Luch.

ctx.x: Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. became favorable to Jess. Little sparks sprung up here and there. Mysterious posters appeared on the walls of Warsaw announcing things like performances. Was extremely simple. Just some hole in the railway workers club. Leopold Thiermann, the former Habitue How do you pronounce it? Habitue? Habitue of the IMCA, who later was to become a well-known writer, arranged a series of concerts with the participation of enthusiastic groups from Warsaw, Krakow, Luch. The public throned the halls in…
Excuse me, why did it happen on All Souls Day?
